hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; before=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null); if out=$(git pull --ff-only --quiet 2>&1); then after=$(git rev-parse HEAD); [ "$before" != "$after" ] && printf "{\"systemMessage\":\"Pulled %s new commit(s) from GitHub.\"}" "$(git rev-list --count "$before..$after")"; else printf "{\"systemMessage\":\"Could not auto-pull from GitHub (the two computers may have different unpushed work). Run git status before editing.\"}"; fi; exit 0
